dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Can you describe exactly where the stomach pain is and how long you have been feeling it?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: The pain is mostly around the middle of my stomach. It started two days ago and sometimes gets stronger after I eat.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you vomited, had diarrhea, or felt sick when trying to eat?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I feel a little sick sometimes, but I have not vomited and I have not had diarrhea.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also eaten much less than usual since yesterday. Last night he felt very warm, so I checked his temperature.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: What temperature did you measure, and what type of thermometer did you use?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: It was thirty eight point four degrees Celsius. I checked it twice with our digital thermometer.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Has the pain moved toward the lower right side of the abdomen at any point?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. It has mostly stayed around the middle and has not moved to the right side.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. I will examine your abdomen carefully and we will decide whether you need any further tests today.
